name: campus_guide_basic_land_goes_on_top_after_the_shuffle
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, you may search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.' Seat 0's library holds, under the six filler cards, a Forest, a nonbasic Desert and a creature. Campus Guide enters; seat 0 searches and picks the Forest: after the shuffle the Forest is the top card of the library, and every other card is still in the library (nine cards). The opponent's library is untouched.
